title: The pill that rides the line's tip

members.role: a value pill riding the line's tip, popping at `build_to`'s datum
the line builds along the page to the datum the sentence has just named
the hand writes the figure at the datum the pill stopped on

does: The number is never hunted for: a value pill rides the tip of the line as it builds and pops at the datum the sentence named, and the hand writes the figure there.
